svg.desc: A question's life Follow the numbered records through five roles; time grows from seconds to hours. Owner Lead Executor Plain programs Files reject Did tuning skip a model? Original message stays. Create an event from the message. Wake the Executor chat. Question kind: design. Lead answers in exchange notes. Create contract; queue work. Run on an available GPU. Create the completion event. First line is a number. Accept or send work back. Retain the accepted result. One result sentence in discussion. A rejected delivery returns to Executor; the original question and evidence remain linked. Owner asks seconds Record message seconds Night watch seconds Bridge wakes seconds ask #2884 minutes answer #2884 minutes Task + queue minutes Dispatcher hours Job done hours Deliver: 3 minutes Review minutes Write finding seconds Result arrives seconds
